identificationModule.briefTitle: An Explorative Study of HRS-2189 Combined With Adebrelimab and BP102 for Metastatic Colorectal Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Explorative Study of HRS-2189 Combined With Adebrelimab and BP102 for Metastatic Colorectal Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To evaluate the safety and efficacy of HRS-2189 combined with Adebrelimab and BP102 in the treatment of metastatic colorectal cancer

primaryOutcomes.description: the proportion of patients with complete response or partial response, using RECIST v 1.1.

secondaryOutcomes.description: time from enrollment to the first documented disease progression or death due to any cause, whichever occurs first. Responses are according to the Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors version 1.1 (RECIST 1.1) as assessed by investigator
time from enrollment to death from any cause.
the proportion of patients with complete response, partial response or stable disease, using RECIST v 1.1.
AEs are assessed by NCI-CTCAE v5.0
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From the first drug administration to within 90 days for the last dose
